verdict.rationale: FreshBooks' own accounting page says you can link bank accounts and use automated bank reconciliation workflows, so the core capability exists first-party. Nothing shows how reconciliation surfaces matched, unmatched or duplicate transactions for review. Nothing confirms per-account reconciliation against the ledger. missing for 10: documented matched/unmatched transaction views, duplicate-transaction detection, per-bank-account reconciliation against the ledger, review workflow details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: FreshBooks lets you link your bank account and create automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management
Keep your books organized with 100+ integrations and automations like embedded payroll and bank reconciliation.
